# Agentic Tools

> Guided workflows for developers building apps and integrations on the Meta Social Technologies Developer Platform (developers.facebook.com): settings, webhooks, compliance, app review, and API health. Requires the Meta Social Technologies MCP (formerly Meta Developer Tools MCP).

## MCP Tools

The skills discover tools from their required connected MCP servers. Developer Platform workflows use `devtools`; `whatsapp-business-marketing-messages-max-price-setup` uses only `whatsapp_business_tools`, which must be added and authenticated separately. Installing a skill does not connect MCP.

## Workflows

### App Health Check
Identify the app first — accept an app name or app_id, resolving a name to its app_id via devtools_app_list. Then run basic_settings, security, compliance status, and app review status in parallel for that app. Produce an actionable report with prioritized action items.

### Webhook Setup
List available topics, collect subscription details (topic, fields, callback_url, verify_token), subscribe, then send a test payload to verify delivery.

### App Review Prep
Check review status, requirements, privileges, and submission history. Check compliance for blockers. Produce a readiness verdict.

### Debug Webhooks
Inspect active subscriptions, send test payloads, diagnose common issues (missing subscriptions, wrong fields, unreachable callback URL).

### Compliance Check
Pull compliance status, app settings, and DPO info. Categorize findings by severity (violations, required actions, recommendations) and provide remediation guidance.

### API Health
Check rate limits, call volume (with optional endpoint filter and lookback window), and API deprecations. Rate limit thresholds: 80% = warning, 100% = throttled. Prioritize action items by severity.

### API Integration
Guide a developer through setting up a Meta API integration (WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Pages, Ads, etc.). Run multiple layered doc searches covering overview, authentication, permissions, endpoints, webhooks, and code examples. Cross-reference app permissions if app_id is provided. Produce a complete integration guide with prerequisites, setup steps, code examples, and common pitfalls.

### Search Docs
Search Meta developer documentation with refined queries. Synthesize answers from results rather than just listing links.

### WhatsApp Business Integration
Set up WhatsApp Business messaging end to end: app, business link, phone number, webhooks, template and first message. Needs both the devtools and whatsapp_business_tools MCP servers. Start with whatsapp_biz_businesses and whatsapp_biz_onboarding_status to resume rather than redo.

### Max Price Setup
Grouped under plugins/devtools/skills/marketing-messages/whatsapp-business-marketing-messages-max-price-setup alongside the existing flat skills. Claude/Cursor declare both skill roots; Codex retains its recursive root. The grouping folder is not a skill and does not change the namespaced leaf identity. Uses only whatsapp_business_tools and declares it in metadata.mcp. Discover tools before deciding the connection is missing. Establish the selected business/account, inspect the template, explain holiday/cohort choices, collect explicit pricing, preview, approve the exact settings, and verify the applied result. Preserve content and omitted settings; no invented numeric policy, automatic restoration or message sending.

### Debug Access Token
Diagnose why a Meta access token is failing (expired, wrong scopes, wrong app, invalid) without the raw token ever entering the agent or AI provider context. Guide the developer to inspect the token themselves via the Access Token Debugger web tool or the public debug_token Graph API, then interpret only the redacted metadata they bring back.
